subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: The Pyramids: Engineering Before Science
description: One-minute skill: The Pyramids: Engineering Before Science.

hook.text: The Great Pyramid contains 2.3 million stone blocks. Each weighs more than a car.

buildup.text: Egyptians had no iron tools, no wheels, no pulleys. They built it in about 20 years.

discovery.text: Ramps, levers, and wet sand. Simple tools used with extraordinary precision and logistics.

twist.text: The base is level to within 2 centimeters across 230 meters. Modern builders struggle to match that.

climax.text: Engineering existed for millennia before anyone called it engineering.

punchline.text: No science. No math degree. Just 2.3 million blocks of proof.

quiz.question: How level is the base of the Great Pyramid?
options: Within 2 meters across its full base
It slopes noticeably from east to west
